offering_description.value: Produces and sells frozen potato products, mainly french fries and other specialty potato items, to quick-service restaurants, other foodservice customers, and retail grocery customers. It makes the products in its own plants and ships them frozen through its global distribution network.

primary_products.value: french fries; specialty potato products; frozen appetizers; retail frozen potato products

customer_segment.value: B2B: quick-service restaurant chains, foodservice distributors, restaurants, retail grocery chains

end_markets.value: restaurants; food service; retail grocery; food processing

revenue_model.value: product sales: frozen potato products sold to restaurants, foodservice distributors and retailers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: processes raw potatoes into frozen products, sold to restaurant chains, distributors and grocers; brand owner: sells some branded retail frozen potato products under its own consumer brands

geography_served.value: global: sells in more than 100 countries, with plants in North America, Europe and Asia Pacific

specialization.value: niche specialist: frozen potato products across foodservice and retail channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to large restaurant chains and national accounts; distributors / dealers: foodservice distributors that deliver to restaurants; third-party retail: grocery chains and retail stores selling branded frozen potato products
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety and labeling rules from FDA and USDA, plus environmental and workplace safety rules

notes: Company size and some sales detail are judgments from public knowledge and may change.
